name: ProgressComparison

usage: Use ProgressComparison to enhance your user interface. This component provides a consistent, accessible, and well-designed solution for this use case.
ProgressComparison integrates seamlessly with other components in the design system. Follow the established patterns and guidelines to ensure consistency across your application.

props.name: title
props.description: Panel title, e.g. "Ground Floor". Omit to hide the title line (e.g. when shown elsewhere).

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Secondary line under the title, e.g. "Floor | HOUSE-12-F0".

props.name: primary
props.description: Left/primary source, rendered dark — most commonly the actual / approved value.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Right/secondary source, rendered lighter — most commonly the planned / baseline value.

props.name: variance
props.description: Variance shown in the pill. Defaults to `primary.value - secondary.value`.

props.name: stats
props.description: Stat cells. Rendered as a 2-column table with edge-to-edge dividers; expands to any count.

props.name: variant
props.description: `progress` shows a status chip; `milestone` shows a stepper timeline; `preview` shows an image preview + an action button (pass `image` / `action`). Default `progress`.

props.name: image
props.description: Preview media for the `preview` variant (e.g. an `` or map). Rendered letterboxed on a muted backdrop.

props.name: status
props.description: Status chip (progress variant) or the label to the right of "Milestones" (milestone variant).

props.name: stepperTitle
props.description: Heading shown above the stepper in the milestone variant. Default "Milestones".

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Show a working collapse button that minimizes the panel to its header (self-managed). Ignored when `onClose` is set. The button is hidden unless `onClose` or `collapsible` is provided.

props.name: collapsedSummary
props.description: When collapsed, also show a summary row beneath the header — the status chip on the left and the primary value on the right — instead of collapsing to the title alone. Default false.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Start in the collapsed state (self-managed collapse only; ignored when `onClose` is set). Default false.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
